tools.name: get_similar_offers
tools.description: Find current offers similar to an offer returned by Dajsve. Useful for comparison before the user opens a merchant link.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search current offers aggregated by dajsve.com. Use Croatian search terms. Returns Dajsve offer details and a clickUrl that takes the user to the original merchant offer.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Get full details for one Dajsve offer and a small set of current alternatives. Use the offerId returned by search_offers.
